{{Quote|Well, you see, since we're a small operation, we don't fall into the jurisdiction of the Empire.''"<br />"''So you're part of the Mining Guild, then?''"<br />"''No, not actually. Our operation is small enough not to be noticed.|Lando Calrissian explains Cloud City to Leia Organa|<ref name="ESB" />}}
'''Samara Kebyc''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] working in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], was a senior [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] for the [[Cloud City Miner's Guild]], [[Administrator/Legends|administering]] the annual dues of the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] with membership in the organization. Kebyc opposed corruption, acting at [[Time/Legends|times]] against other members of the guild. She was present in Cloud City when [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], called for an evacuation before [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces could [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugate]] the mining operation.

==Biography==
[[File:Kebyc-esb.png|thumb|left|270px|Kebyc holds a conversation with other Bespinites.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]],<ref name="db" /> Samara Kebyc<ref name="Insider 148">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> worked in<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Kebyc}}</ref> the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna gas]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|colony]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] above<ref name="ESB" /> her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="db" /> the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ESB" /> There, she was a member of the [[Cloud City Miner's Guild]],<ref name="CCG" /> an organization under the jurisdiction of Cloud City's [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="BAT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref> The Miner's Guild was not part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]], the attentions of which the Cloud City [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation was too small to attract.<ref name="ESB" /> Kebyc served as a senior [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] for the guild, and her duties included [[Administrator/Legends|administration]] of the members' annual dues.<ref name="CCG" />

Kebyc sought to end corruption among other members of the Miner's Guild.<ref name="CCG" /> With the aid of [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] [[Gir Endac]], she tracked down several corrupt guild officials.<ref name="Insider 148" />

Kebyc was present in a Cloud City corridor<ref name="ESB" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> conversing with other [[Bespinite/Legends|residents]], as Calrissian led [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]&mdash;representatives of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]&mdash;past on the way to a meeting in which Calrissian handed the three over to the custody of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in an effort to prevent further Imperial intervention in Cloud City's operation. When Imperial forces nonetheless descended upon Cloud City to [[Occupation of Bespin|occupy]] the facility in violation of his agreement with Vader, Calrissian ordered the city's inhabitants to evacuate.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
Samara Kebyc fought corruption among the members of the guild.<ref name="Insider 148" /> She had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
Kebyc<ref name="Insider 148" /> wore a gray robe over pants of the same color, and wore dark shoes.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Samara Kebyc first appeared as an unnamed and uncredited extra in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], in which she can be seen having a discussion as Lando Calrissian, Han Solo, Princess Leia, and Chewbacca walk past.<ref name="ESB" /> She was provided a surname and a detailed character history through the [[November]] [[1997]] ''[[Cloud City Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> The [[March 11]], [[2014]]<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref> [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] department from [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]] first identified her full name.<ref name="Insider 148" />
